description: Integrity inventory and public distribution evidence. Ordinary CI validates bytes and structure; --release requires actual redistribution license/notice obligations. Separate maintenanceItems do not block publication.

known.description: Archive includes CMake, GNU Make and Ninja; historical scripts name CMake 3.28.1, Make 4.4.1 and Ninja 1.12.1, not a proof of actual binaries.

releaseRequirements.requirement: Include GNU Make corresponding source/build material and all component and linked-library license notices; a CPack template is insufficient.

maintenanceItems.requirement: Record actual binary versions, exact source revisions, all patches and portable build recipes.

releaseRequirements.requirement: Inventory all included compiler runtimes, Android sysroot and shared-library components; retain their actual copyright/license notices and satisfy source obligations only where their own licenses require them.

maintenanceItems.requirement: Verify the claimed compiler source revision against the archive and record available fork sources and local patches for future maintenance.

Provide a portable build recipe for these Clang 21 archives; the historical LLVM 18 scripts are not that recipe. This is a maintenance requirement, not an unconditional Apache-2.0 source-disclosure obligation.

known.description: Archive filename names Zsh 5.9; two plugin license files are present.

releaseRequirements.requirement: Include actual shell, ncurses, plugin and other linked-library copyright/license notices. Source availability is required only for components whose licenses impose it.

maintenanceItems.requirement: Record actual Zsh/ncurses and plugin versions, exact source revisions, patches and a portable build recipe for future maintenance.
